name: Eating Shrimp
overview: Scripture clearly outlines dietary distinctions concerning aquatic creatures, emphasizing that only those with fins and scales are permissible to eat, as stated in Leviticus 11:9-12 and Deuteronomy 14:9. Shrimp, lacking fins and scales, fall under what the Lord declares an abomination in these passages. These instructions reflect God's holiness and His desire for His people to live distinctively, honoring Him through obedience to His commands.
